draft_answer: Speaker B (the User Interface Designer) initially suggested using a small lithium battery because of its longer life and availability. Another member, Speaker D (the Marketing Expert), preferred AAA batteries instead, noting they are lighter and more come in a package. However, the team ultimately chose a lithium battery during the final pricing discussion.
